epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized role spoofing access from baseline to 0%
requirements: R1: Generate a secure session token (JWT) upon successful login.
R2: Validate the JWT on all subsequent requests, rejecting header-based role spoofing.

slices.title: Patch Authentication to use JWT instead of headers
slices.jtbd: When implementing the JWT patch for this epic, I want to enforce token generation and validation, so that unauthorized users cannot spoof roles.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on the login screen, When they provide valid credentials, Then a secure session token (JWT) is generated and returned.
Given an incoming request, When it lacks a valid JWT but provides a role spoofing header, Then the request is rejected as unauthorized.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease rate of successful unauthorized requests via header spoofing to 0
